environment.description: NestJS pricing microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in a VPC with public subnets. The ALB is internet-facing with no authentication. Security group allows inbound on ports 3000 and 3001 from 0.0.0.0/0. No request validation middleware. Node.js 18 runtime without --frozen-intrinsics flag.

config.network: Public subnet, internet-facing ALB, SG ingress 0.0.0.0/0:3000,3001
